DARV.talk.ZHIJIANG_CHARACTER_BELLA_CHARA: Oh, all these shiny treasures... can I pick one? I promise I'll use it well on stage!
Bella!? The one who dances and sparkles! Ha, take whatever you like from that pile!
I've been saving something special for no one but you!
A gift for the Bellaris? Then I'd better accept it seriously!
Nice!! Such a good kid! Take it—the Bellaris are sure to be happy!
NEOW.talk.ZHIJIANG_CHARACTER_BELLA_CHARA: The lights are going up again... the show's just beginning, isn't it?

[sine]..I remember.. your first... dance..
...all to make.. the crowd.. smile.....[/sine]
Then... let this light stay on for me one last time. My Bellaris are all watching.

[sine]...I will.. keep.. lighting.. you...
...this time.. too.. no.. exception.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.ZHIJIANG_CHARACTER_BELLA_: Such a gorgeous room! But honestly, I'd rather give you a farewell dance than get dressed up.
Oh, the big star! Let me dress you up brighter than the stage lights!
Even while waiting for the grand finale, you shouldn't look so down!
The one who saves their best look for the end is the most moving... want to borrow some sequins first?
No outfit shines brighter than those fans who've screamed my name hoarse down there.
Really... then take that spirit with you to the finale, little one!
OROBAS.talk.ZHIJIANG_CHARACTER_BELLA_CHA: Wow, so noisy here! But... this feels exactly like a concert!
The one who sings and dances?! Perfect!! Give me passion!! Rhythm!!
Still working up a sweat!! Great!! That's what a stage is for!!
Here's something good!! Want to swap out that old gear of yours??
If it lets me last a little longer on stage... then let's swap!
Great!! Then it's settled: you keep dancing, and I keep making noise!!
PAEL.talk.ZHIJIANG_CHARACTER_BELLA_CHARA: Quiet, like backstage... perfect, I can rehearse my steps here.
[thinky_dots]A dancing child... take a little of my stillness... so you can stand firm amid the noise...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Still practicing... good... then practice my sleep in too...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]The longer one can stand, the longer one can dance... the peace you want, I'll share half...[/thinky_dots]
Thank you. Don't worry—I'll stay under my own spotlight until the very end.
TANX.talk.ZHIJIANG_CHARACTER_BELLA_CHARA: Fighting's not my specialty... but I'm the one who trains the hardest!
[b]A dancer wants to fight?! Then let me show you what real sweat is!![/b]
[b]Still full of energy!! Good!! Take that stubbornness into battle!![/b]
[b]Stop waiting for a perfect farewell!! End it with this victory!![/b]
I insist on waiting for the very finale... until then, no one's stopping me.
[b]Stubborn!! But brave!! Take this weapon and stand until the end!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.ZHIJIANG_CHARACTER_BELLA_: Warm, cozy... just like everyone gathered together before a show.
Ah, the one carrying starlight! Come in, let me [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter] you right up!
Still carrying that heavy bag of [jitter][b]expectations[/b][/jitter]? Put it down and rest!
Here, taste this [jitter][b]beef jerky[/b][/jitter] I made for you. No rush—the crowd will wait for you.
I can't take my time... my Bellaris are all gathered for this very moment.
Alright, then tuck it in your pocket and keep running!
VAKUU.talk.ZHIJIANG_CHARACTER_BELLA_CHAR: Time... for me, it's for rehearsing, for standing on stage, and for waiting for my Bellaris.
Worthless [sine]time[/sine]... once it's been gathered into a complete show... it's worth a lot...
I sell "right now" at a high price. What you want... is [sine]"forever"[/sine]?
If I wrote a tiny line at the bottom: allowed to [sine]dance forever[/sine]—would you sign?
I'd sign. As long as someone down there still holds up a light stick, I won't leave the stage.
Take it. I'll never call you to stop—unless your [sine]light[/sine] truly goes out.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ZHIJIANG_CHARACTER_BE: You stand here, yet the whole tower feels like your stage. Are you waiting for a curtain call, or for approval?
I'm waiting for that "one more time" from the crowd. Until then, I haven't finished singing.
One more time? You never needed to. You're just afraid of the moment the applause fades.
You returned. Time is a chorus on repeat to you—you won't end it because you haven't sung enough.
The chorus is nice. The curtain call isn't. The curtain call means... no more applause.
Foolish. If you refuse to drop the beat, you'll forever be an echo.
Then stand. The tower will remember you: you came many times, yet never left the stage.
Leaving the stage... would that make me no longer needed?
It would. So don't stop. Keep singing—it's the only weapon you excel at.
